{{Quote|Do you think I am afraid to die? I am the Gormak King. I walk where Voss do not dare go.|Jokull|<ref name="The Gormak King">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Gormak King|Voss}}</ref>}}
'''Jokull''' was the proclaimed [[King/Legends|King]] of all [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="The Gormak King" />

==Biography==
Jokull was an unusually very intelligent Gormak, which helped his advancement, as he united the tribes in their hatred against the Voss and ordered the technicians to construct more advanced technology to use against them. But the event that changed his destiny was a travel that Jokull made to the [[Nightmare Lands]], where he met the dark entity [[Sel-Makor]] that gifted him with the power of [[Force vision/Legends|prophecy]]. This power crazed Jokull enough that he came to believe that the [[Voss]], that had similar powers, were all evil and must be destroyed at any cost.
{{GameLSmechanics}}
However, he was brought down by a joint assault of [[Voss commandos]] and outsider forces, capturing him.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jokull can be brought down by both Republic and Imperial players. He can be killed or spared in the Voss quest line in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
